title: Conservation of walk distribution mass
statement: Let $G$ be a finite regular multigraph of positive degree $D$, let $p$ be any rational-valued function on its vertices, and let $k$ be a nonnegative integer. The sum over destination vertices of the walk distribution obtained after $k$ steps from $p$ equals the sum of $p$ over all vertices.
hypotheses_covered: $G$ is a regular multigraph of degree $D$
$p$ is a rational-valued function on the vertices
